briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.8% and S&P 500 -0.6%, no broad risk-on or risk-off signal. Existing positions were held since there's no reason to exit strong names on a quiet day, and we deployed part of the available cash into TALO, the one candidate with complete multi-signal confirmation including a volume surge. Two of three open slots remain unfilled, keeping dry powder for a stronger risk-on setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means a price move is accompanied by higher-than-normal trading volume, which suggests real institutional participation rather than random noise. TALO stood out today because it combined a volume surge with bullish RSI, a MACD crossover, and price above its moving average — all pointing the same direction at once.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「成交量確認」是指價格變動伴隨著明顯高於平常的成交量，顯示背後有真正的機構資金參與，而非隨機雜訊。今日TALO之所以突出，是因為它同時出現成交量暴增、RSI處於偏多區間、MACD黃金交叉，以及股價站上均線——多項訊號同步指向同一方向。

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 slipped modestly today, a broad-based pullback rather than a reaction to any single catalyst. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off trigger, most stocks drifted lower together in a typical neutral, low-conviction session. In quiet sessions like this, individual stock setups with strong technical confirmation stand out more than the overall market direction.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納斯達克及標普500指數均溫和下跌，屬於較廣泛的整體回調，並非單一事件所觸發。市場缺乏明確的risk-on（風險偏好）或risk-off（避險）訊號，大部分股票在低動能、方向不明的交投中同步走弱。在這種平淡的交易日，個別股票若出現強勁技術指標確認，反而比大盤走勢更值得留意。

trades.reasoning: Only candidate showing full five-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge), indicating genuine institutional buying despite the broader neutral tape.
